message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on the fact: abandonment of a newborn child. In Chinese criminal law, abandoning a child (especially a newborn) is a crime of "遗弃" (abandonment). The relevant article is Criminal Law Article 260 (or 261?) Actually Article 260: "遗弃被监护的未成年人或者不能自理的老人、病人等" is punishable. For newborn, also "遗弃婴儿" is a crime. So the charge is "遗弃罪" (abandonment). In examples, they used "遗弃" maybe "遗弃罪". The format: [罪名]遗弃<eoa>.

Thus answer.
